Package edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data

package edu.mit.rocket_team.util.data
Mutable engineering-unit payloads at the simulator-to-instrument boundary and firmware recovery status codes. Raw ADC fields may be NaN when simulator inputs cannot supply hardware counts.
